title: fun-lab: achievement and prize grants, inventory and redemption

contract.summary: Granting by slug: an achievement is held once per profile; a prize is repeatable until its inventory runs out; inactive entities and opted-out subjects are refused; a slug is resolved to an achievement before a prize. A refusal is a result with a message, never an exception. Prize grants move granted -> claimed -> fulfilled.

functions.scenario: scenario(input: {clock, config?, subjects, steps}) -> {steps: [{result, events}]}, as in fun-lab/progression.

contract.referenceNote: Goldens are laravel-fun-lab's own engine driven through its public API by tests/Conformance/ScenarioRunner.php and written by tests/Conformance/ExportFixturesTest.php. Inputs are authored in fancy-conformance/scripts/fun-lab/grants.input.json.

notes: No discrimination probes, for the reason given in fun-lab/progression.
